argument_markdown:
Source-backed inputs.

ATT-0120, dual-confirmed by REV-0169 and REV-0170, supplies the atlas-independent reduced closed support Y, the ordinary open-restriction map r_T, and the named pure weight -16 sub-Hodge structure T_Z = ker(r_T) inside T. The supports group itself is not identified with T_Z; only its image under the supports map equals the kernel.

ATT-0130, dual-confirmed by REV-0180 and REV-0181, supplies an admissible chain Y = Y^(0) superset ... superset Y^(N) = empty and a decreasing filtration A_j of T_Z. For a stratum S_(n) of dimension n, let G_n denote its graded piece. The verified assertion is only that G_n is a subquotient of W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_(n);Q)(n). The pieces vanish for n <= 7 and n >= 17, and the n = 8 piece is a finite direct sum of Q(8). Semisimplicity gives a noncanonical direct-sum splitting of T_Z into these graded pieces.

Residual audit.

For n = 9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16, the respective source degrees are 2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16. Thus 0 <= 2n-16 <= n throughout the residual range. Negative-degree vanishing does not apply, and Artin vanishing for an affine coarse space requires degree strictly greater than its dimension, so it does not apply either, including at equality for n = 16.

The primary balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl context identifies fibrewise obstruction geometry and an ordered reduced-support incidence, but it supplies no proved ordinary-cohomology calculation for any S_(n), no proved affine paving or mixed-Tate stratification of those strata, and no map proving that a source class survives in G_n. Its recorded frontier obligations include the mixed Hodge structures of ordering-cover components and the stack-level comparison with the image closure in M_{6,6}. Those obligations cannot be treated as inputs. Rational S_6 representation theory or a finite branch morphism cannot create Tate cohomology, as explicitly prohibited by the mathematical constraints.

Semisimplicity removes extension ambiguity only after the simple factors of each G_n are known; it does not force an arbitrary pure weight -16 Hodge structure to be Tate. Conversely, non-Tate cohomology in a source group would not disprove the theorem unless a non-Tate subquotient were proved to survive in the named G_n and hence in T_Z.

Gap.

No occurring G_n for 9 <= n <= 16 is proved zero or a finite direct sum of Q(8). Therefore the verified sufficiency implication cannot be applied. No non-Tate G_n is proved either, so there is also no disproof through the required target interface.

Computational hypotheses and experiments: none.

gap_markers.blocking_effect: Without this residual resolution, ATT-0130/CLM-0130-5 does not imply that T_Z is Tate; without a proved non-Tate survivor in some G_n, the exact theorem is not disproved either.
gap_markers.statement: For one fixed admissible chain, every occurring graded piece G_n with 9 <= n <= 16 must be proved zero or a finite direct sum of Q(8). No admitted input determines W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_(n);Q) sufficiently or determines the image subquotient G_n.

First confirmation of ATT-0120. Its supports-group-versus-image caveat is respected.
Second confirmation of ATT-0120 and its target-interface certificate.

Verified C66-SUPPORT-FILTRATION result. Used through CLM-0130-1 through CLM-0130-5 for the admissible chain, subquotient filtration, endpoint resolutions, noncanonical splitting, and residual sufficiency implication.
First confirmation of ATT-0130, including the limitation that residual pieces are subquotients rather than identified supports groups.
Second confirmation of ATT-0130. Its restrictions against unproved degeneration, Kunneth, algebraic-generation, and motivic upgrades are respected.

summary: The verified interface ATT-0120 and verified filtration ATT-0130 reduce the exact target to the occurring graded pieces in dimensions 9 through 16. None of the admitted inputs determines those pieces, proves them zero, or proves them Tate. In this range the source degree 2n-16 is nonnegative and at most n, so neither endpoint argument of ATT-0130 applies. The graded pieces are only subquotients of the displayed source groups, and no admitted Casnati–Ekedahl input computes their images in T_Z. Consequently ATT-0132 records the precise residual gap and does not claim a proof or disproof.

target_interface_reference.chain_and_strata: Fix one admissible ATT-0130 chain Y = Y^(0) superset ... superset Y^(N) = empty. Its dimensions strictly decrease, and S_(n) denotes the unique smooth affine-coarse stratum of dimension n when it occurs. The associated graded piece G_n is only a subquotient of W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_(n);Q)(n).
target_interface_reference.residual_piece_resolution: Unresolved. For every occurring n with 9 <= n <= 16, ATT-0132 proves neither that G_n vanishes nor that G_n is a finite direct sum of Q(8). It also proves no non-Tate G_n. The verified endpoint arguments do not apply because 0 <= 2n-16 <= n.
target_interface_reference.target_map_use: The only target map used is the inclusion T_Z = ker(r_T) into T constructed in ATT-0120 from W_{26} of ordinary open restriction, twisted by (21). No supports group is identified with its image, and no Gysin map, proper pushforward, fundamental class, or unproved map from Y or Z to T is used.
target_interface_reference.target_subquotient: T_Z = K_Z = ker(r_T), the pure weight -16 subobject of T := W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) = W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21) defined by ATT-0120/CLM-0120-4 from ordinary open restriction to M_{6,6} minus Y.
target_interface_reference.unconditional_conclusion: No unconditional Tate or non-Tate conclusion for the named T_Z is established in ATT-0132. The exact theorem is neither proved nor disproved, and complementary target terms are not assembled.

excluded_claims: a disproof from non-Tate cohomology not proved to survive in the named T_Z
identification of a graded piece with its source cohomology group

the occurring residual graded pieces in dimensions 9 through 16
theorem_scope.outcome: The exact theorem is neither proved nor disproved by this artifact.

theorem_statement: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum, and take as given the support filtration of a verified C66-SUPPORT-FILTRATION result: an admissible chain for Y, and a finite filtration of T_Z by sub-Hodge structures whose graded pieces are indexed by the stratum dimensions n of that chain, each a subquotient of W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_{(n)};Q)(n), zero for n <= 7 and for n >= 17, a finite direct sum of Q(8) for n = 8, and at most one per dimension, so that at most eight pieces remain, at most one for each n with 9 <= n <= 16. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). By the verified implication of that filtration it is sufficient to fix one admissible chain and prove, for each of its strata of dimension n with 9 <= n <= 16, that the corresponding graded piece is a finite direct sum of Q(8), for instance by determining W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_{(n)};Q) or by proving that the graded piece vanishes; any other complete proof of the displayed conclusion is equally admissible. A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof, and neither is a non-Tate group W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_{(n)};Q) unless the corresponding graded piece of the verified filtration is itself proved non-Tate. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.
